rulings.why: The page cannot tell these changes from the row: split:refrain.1.1: Refrain, end of system 3's middle row: Bible is printed with a capital as a proper name, as it is mid-line in every stanza's first row on p265-strip0.jpg. The word before it carries no mark, and the header's 11.10.11.10 holds the stanzas only (Ref., no refrain metre). join:refrain.1.2: Refrain system 5's row (p266-strip0.jpg): its first word, Precept, follows the full stop that ends system 4's row on p265-strip1600.jpg, so its capital stands anyway. The header gives the refrain no metre.

readings: the shape readings of the page (data/shapes.json)
rulings.why: The page tells these changes from the row (`can`), or the judge could not tell (`unclear`), but no check of the shape readings does: join:refrain.1.1: can: Refrain system 4's row (p265-strip1600.jpg): Thy is printed with a capital after a comma. It addresses the holy message shining just before it (the Bible), which the page prints lowercase, so it is no pronoun of God and its capital marks a line opening, which the join removes.
